title: Upsample
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Operations/Upsample.md
text: Resample input at higher rate by inserting zeros, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial conditions} sets Initial conditions; {Upsample factor source} sets the mode of specifying upsample factor, {Upsample factor, L}, {Sample offset (0 to L−1)}, {Maximum upsample factor, Lmax}, {Input processing} sets the method to process input signals Columns and {Rate options} sets the method to upsample input Enforce single-rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upsample factor source
params.values: Mode of specifying upsample factor Dialog parameter (default) | Input port

params.name: Sample offset (0 to L−1)
params.values: Sample offset 0 (default) | integer in the range [0, L −1]

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process input signals Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Method to upsample input Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing
